# dnswiz_pool (Resource)

A GSLB pool of endpoints with a selection algorithm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dnswiz_pool" "web" {
  name              = "web-eu"
  description       = "EU-region web servers"
  health_monitor_id = dnswiz_health_monitor.https.id
  selection_method  = "weighted"
}

resource "dnswiz_pool_member" "web_a" {
  pool_id     = dnswiz_pool.web.id
  endpoint_id = dnswiz_endpoint.web_a.id
  weight      = 100
}

resource "dnswiz_pool_member" "web_b" {
  pool_id     = dnswiz_pool.web.id
  endpoint_id = dnswiz_endpoint.web_b.id
  weight      = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `health_monitor_id` (String) ID of the health monitor used to probe pool members.
- `name` (String) Pool name, unique within the tenant.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description shown in the console.
- `selection_method` (String) Load-balancing algorithm. One of `weighted`, `active-passive`, `round-robin`.

### Read-Only

- `health_score` (Number) Pool health score, 0 to 100. Computed from member up/total.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `member_count` (Number) Number of members in the pool. Computed.
